title: Multiproof manual walk after thinker pass
summary: Manual walk of AggregateVerifier + TEEProverRegistry + TEEVerifier + ZKVerifier + NitroEnclaveVerifier guided by 46 thinker hypotheses. Walked claimCredit, resolve, challenge, nullify, _verifyTeeProof, _verifyZkProof, _verifyL1Origin (EIP-2935 + blockhash), _verifyJournal (cert chain validation). All hypotheses dispositioned: trust_mapper false alarms (caller-class doesn't see inline guards), value_flow claimCredit checked, invariant_inferrer proofCount maintained. Already-known TEEProverRegistry init/setGameType asymmetry confirmed OOS.
key_lesson: After thinker pass, manually walk each top-confidence hypothesis to its disposition. Capture the hypothesis-disposition table - it's the calibration data for tuning thinkers and the proof that the surface is exhausted.
